value.rationale: The exact homotopy classification of an infinite natural family of complete-graph coloring orbit spaces answers a question not resolved by existing rational characters. It determines all integral and homotopy invariants of each full-color quotient, supplies a canonical constructive contraction, and identifies singular m-armed-star quotients showing that the result is not merely a general ball-quotient slogan. The object and precise invariant are classically motivated.
